pages.title: Shasta Ground Sloth
pages.text: The Shasta ground sloth ($(o)Nothrotheriops shastensis$()) was a small ground sloth of the deserts and canyons of south-western North America.$(br2)It weighed about 250 kilograms, with a narrow snout, a coarse shaggy coat, long curved claws and a thick tail it leaned on when rearing up to browse.$(br2)Its dried dung, preserved in caves such as Rampart Cave in the Grand Canyon, shows it ate yucca, globemallow and Joshua tree. It vanished about 13,000 years ago.
